paittasya liṅgena samānaliṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ cāpyaparaṃ nibodha
na spandate nodarameti vṛddhiṃ bhavanti liṅgāni ca garbhiṇīnām
taṃ garbhakālātigame cikitsyam asṛgbhavaṃ gulmamuśanti tajjñāḥ
cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ vāpi ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam
tasya mātrāṃ pibeddadhnā surayā sarpiṣāpi vā
lavaṇaṃ vṛkṣabījaṃ ca tulyaṃ syādanavo guḍaḥ
pathyābhir vā yutaṃ cūrṇaṃ gavāṃ mūtrayutaṃ pacet
gulme raktaṃ jalaukobhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇa vā haret
peyā vātaharaiḥ siddhāḥ kaulatthāḥ saṃskṛtā rasāḥ
ūrdhvavātaṃ manuṣyaṃ ca gulminaṃ na nirūhayet
gugguluṃ trivṛtāṃ dantīṃ dravantīṃ saindhavaṃ vacām
evaṃ pīlūni bhṛṣṭāni pibet salavaṇāni tu
yuktā hanti surā gulmaṃ śīghraṃ kāle prayojitā
vāyvādibhir yathāsaṅkhyāṃ miśrair vā vīkṣya yojayet
na khādedālukaṃ gulmī madhurāṇi phalāni ca
nidānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi rūpaṃ ca sacikitsitam
tṛṣṇā dāho mado mūrcchā tīvraṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva ca
śūlānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ cikitsāṃ tu nibodha me
āśukārī hi pavanastasmāt taṃ tvarayā jayet
pāyasaiḥ kṛśarāpiṇḍaiḥ snigdhair vā piśitair hitaḥ
madyena vātajaṃ śūlaṃ kṣipram eva praśāmyati
tāni cūrṇāni payasā pibet kāmbalikena vā
sā vartirvātikaṃ śūlaṃ kṣipram eva vyapohati
guḍatailena vā līḍhā pītā madyena vā punaḥ
sa sukhaṃ chardayitvā tu pītvā śītodakaṃ naraḥ
guḍaḥ śāliryavāḥ kṣīraṃ sarpiḥ pānaṃ virecanam
aśane bhuktamātre tu prakopaḥ ślaiṣmikasya ca
rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ prayojyaḥ syādanyāścoṣṇāḥ kriyā hitāḥ
saindhavaṃ tumburuṃ pathyāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu pāyayet
sarpiḥ plīhodaroktaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ vā hiṅgusaṃyutam
tadāsya bhojanaṃ bhuktaṃ sopastambhaṃ na pacyate
naivāsane na śayane tiṣṭhan vā labhate sukham
nāgaraṃ dīpyakaṃ cavyaṃ hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ viḍam
malaṃ ruṇaddhi koṣṭhasthaṃ mandīkṛtya tu pāvakam
dakṣiṇaṃ yadi vā vāmaṃ kukṣimādāya jāyate
pipāsā vardhate tīvrā bhramo mūrcchā ca jāyate
kṣipraṃ doṣaharaṃ kāryaṃ bhiṣajā sādhu jānatā
atimātraṃ yadā bhuktaṃ pāvake mṛdutāṃ gate
dūṣayitvā rasaṃ doṣā viguṇā hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ
kurvanti hṛdaye bādhāṃ hṛdrogaṃ taṃ pracakṣate
caturvidhaḥ sa doṣaiḥ syāt kṛmibhiśca pṛthak pṛthak
nirmathyate dīryate ca sphoṭyate pāṭyate 'pi ca
dhūmāyanaṃ ca mūrcchā ca svedaḥ śoṣo mukhasya ca
utkleśaḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ todaḥ śūlo hṛllāsakas tamaḥ
kṛmije kṛmijātīnāṃ ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ ca ye matāḥ
tṛptasya ca rasair mukhyair madhuraiḥ saghṛtair bhiṣak
cūrṇaṃ tu pāyayetoktaṃ vātaje bhojayecca tam
vyavāyamamlaṃ lavaṇāni madyaṃ mṛdaṃ divāsvapnamatīva tīkṣṇam
niṣevamāṇasya vidūṣya raktaṃ kurvanti doṣāstvaci pāṇḍubhāvam
pāṇḍvāmayo 'ṣṭārdhavidhaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ pṛthaksamastair yugapac ca doṣaiḥ
sarveṣu caiteṣviha pāṇḍubhāvo yato 'dhiko 'taḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaḥ
sarvātmake sarvamidaṃ vyavasyed vakṣyāmi liṅgānyatha kāmalāyāḥ
yo hyāmayānte sahasānnam amlam adyād apathyāni ca tasya pittam
karoti pāṇḍuṃ vadanaṃ viśeṣāt pūrveritau tandribalakṣayau ca
bhedastu tasyāḥ khalu kumbhasāhvaḥ śopho mahāṃstatra ca parvabhedaḥ
taṃ vātapittāddharipītanīlaṃ halīmakaṃ nāma vadanti tajjñāḥ
śophastathā kaṇṭhagato 'balatvaṃ mūrcchā klamo hṛdyavapīḍanaṃ ca
sādhyaṃ tu pāṇḍvāmayinaṃ samīkṣya snigdhaṃ ghṛtenordhvamadhaśca śuddham
pibedghṛtaṃ vā rajanīvipakvaṃ yat traiphalaṃ tailvakam eva vāpi
dhātrīphalānāṃ rasamikṣujaṃ ca manthaṃ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī
ubhe bṛhatyau rajanīṃ śukākhyāṃ kākādanīṃ cāpi sakākamācīm
tat pāṇḍutāṃ hantyupayujyamānaṃ kṣīreṇa vā māgadhikā yathāgni
hitaṃ ca yaṣṭīmadhujaṃ kaṣāyaṃ cūrṇaṃ samaṃ vā madhunāvalihyāt
ājaṃ śakṛtsyāt kuḍavapramāṇaṃ viḍaṃ haridrā lavaṇottamaṃ ca
bibhītakāyomalanāgarāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ tilānāṃ ca guḍaśca mukhyaḥ
takrānupāno vaṭakaḥ prayuktaḥ kṣiṇoti ghorān api pāṇḍurogān
sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu kirātatiktaṃ kalāyamātrāṇi sukhāmbunā vā
mūrvāharidrāmalakaṃ ca lihyāt sthitaṃ gavāṃ saptadināni mūtre
sukhāmbunā vā lavaṇena tulyaṃ śigroḥ phalaṃ kṣīrabhujopayojyam
nyagrodhavargasya pibet kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī
śālādikaṃ cāpyatha sāracūrṇaṃ dhātrīphalaṃ vā madhunāvalihyāt
cūrṇāni kṛtvā guḍaśarkare ca tathaiva sarpirmadhunī śubhe ca
jātaṃ ca lehyaṃ matimān viditvā nidhāpayenmokṣakaje samudge
hantyeṣa lehaḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaṃ saśothamugrām api kāmalāṃ ca
saśarkarā kāmalināṃ tribhaṇḍī hitā gavākṣī saguḍā ca śuṇṭhī
kāleyake cāpi ghṛtaṃ vipakvaṃ hitaṃ ca tat syādrajanīvimiśram
dhātuṃ nadījaṃ jatu śailajaṃ vā kumbhāhvaye mūtrayutaṃ pibedvā
mūtre sthitaṃ saindhavasamprayuktaṃ māsaṃ pibedvāpi hi lohakiṭṭam
vicūrṇya līḍhaṃ madhunācireṇa kumbhāhvayaṃ pāṇḍugadaṃ nihanyāt
sindhūdbhavaṃ vāgnisamaṃ ca kṛtvā kṣiptvā ca mūtre sakṛdeva taptam
lauhaṃ ca kiṭṭaṃ bahuśaśca taptvā nirvāpya mūtre bahuśastathaiva
yathā na dahyeta tathā viśuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ peyamudaśvitā tat
takraudanāśī vijayeta rogaṃ pāṇḍuṃ tathā dīpayate 'nalaṃ ca
drākṣāguḍūcyāmalakīrasaiśca siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ lāgharake hitaṃ ca
snigdhān rasānāmalakairupetān kolānvitān vāpi hi jāṅgalānām
seveta śophābhihitāṃśca yogān pāṇḍvāmayī śāliyavāṃśca nityam
anteṣu śūnaṃ parihīnamadhyaṃ mlānaṃ tathānteṣu ca madhyaśūnam
gude ca śephasyatha muṣkaśūnaṃ pratāmyamānaṃ ca visaṃjñakalpam
tataḥ pravartate raktamūrdhvaṃ cādho dvidhāpi vā
ūrdhvaṃ sādhyam adho yāpyam asādhyaṃ yugapadgatam
daurbalyaśvāsakāsajvaravamathumadās tandritādāhamūrcchā bhukte cānne vidāhastvadhṛtirapi sadā hṛdyatulyā ca pīḍā
tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhasya bhedaḥ śirasi ca davanaṃ pūtiniṣṭhīvanaṃ ca dveṣo bhakte 'vipāko viratirapi rate raktapittopasargāḥ
māṃsaprakṣālanābhaṃ kvathitam iva ca yat kardamāmbhonibhaṃ vā medaḥpūyāsrakalpaṃ yakṛd iva yadi vā pakvajambūphalābham
yat kṛṣṇaṃ yacca nīlaṃ bhṛśamatikuṇapaṃ yatra coktā vikārāstadvarjyaṃ raktapittaṃ surapatidhanuṣā yacca tulyaṃ vibhāti
tarpaṇaṃ pācanaṃ lehān sarpīṃṣi vividhāni ca
payāṃsi śītāni rasāśca jāṅgalāḥ satīnayūṣāśca saśāliṣaṣṭikāḥ
hitaṃ ca śākaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛtaṃ sadā tathaiva dhātrīphaladāḍimānvitam
himāḥ pradehā madhurā gaṇāśca ye ghṛtāni pathyāni ca raktapittinām
lihyācca dūrvāvaṭajāṃśca pallavān madhudvitīyān sitakarṇikasya ca
hitaṃ ca kharjūraphalaṃ samākṣikaṃ phalāni cānyānyapi tadguṇānyatha
candanaṃ madhukaṃ rodhram evam eva samaṃ pibet
palāśavṛkṣasvarase vipakvaṃ sarpiḥ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītam
vanaspatīnāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā saśarkaraṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā
sthitaṃ niśāṃ tadrudhirāmayaṃ jayet pītaṃ payo vāmbusamaṃ hitāśinaḥ
turaṅgavarcaḥsvarasaṃ samākṣikaṃ pibet sitākṣaudrayutaṃ vṛṣasya vā
drākṣāṃ sitāṃ tiktakarohiṇīṃ ca himāmbunā vā madhukena yuktām
pathyāmahiṃsrāṃ rajanīṃ ghṛtaṃ ca lihyāttathā śoṇitapittarogī
puṣpāṇi śigrośca vicūrṇya leho madhvanvitaḥ śoṇitapittaroge
jambvarjunāmrakvathitaṃ ca toyaṃ ghnanti trayaḥ pittamasṛk ca yogāḥ
mūlāni puṣpāṇi ca mātuluṅgyāḥ piṣṭvā pibettaṇḍuladhāvanena
ghrāṇapravṛtte jalamāśu deyaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā payo vā
drākṣārasaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā saśarkaraṃ cekṣurasaṃ himaṃ vā
nirūhya cainaṃ payasā samākṣikair ghṛtaplutaiḥ śītajalāvasecitam
virekayoge tvati caiva śasyate vāmyaśca rakte vijite balānvitaḥ
pravṛttarakteṣu ca pāyujeṣu kuryādvidhānaṃ khalu raktapaittam
trayāṇām api doṣāṇāṃ śoṇite 'pi ca sarvaśaḥ
hṛtpīḍā jṛmbhaṇaṃ glāniḥ saṃjñānāśo balasya ca
moho mūrccheti tāṃ prāhuḥ ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā
vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca
tasmād raktasya gandhena mūrchanti bhuvi mānavāḥ
gātrāṇi vikṣipan bhūmau jarāṃ yāvanna yāti tat
sekāvagāhau maṇayaḥ sahārāḥ śītāḥ pradehā vyajanānilāśca
śītāni pānāni ca gandhavanti sarvāsu mūrcchāsvanivāritāni
kharjūrakāśmaryarasaiḥ śṛtāni pānāni sarpīṃṣi ca jīvanāni
siddhāni varge madhure payāṃsi sadāḍimā jāṅgalajā rasāśca
tathā yavā lohitaśālayaśca mūrcchāsu pathyāśca sadā satīnāḥ
bhujaṅgapuṣpaṃ maricānyuśīraṃ kolasya madhyaṃ ca pibet samāni
śītena toyena bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ kṣaudreṇa kṛṣṇāṃ sitayā ca pathyām
mūrcchāṃ prasaktāṃ tu śirovirekair jayedabhīkṣṇaṃ vamanaiśca tīkṣṇaiḥ
harītakīkvāthaśṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā
pibet kaṣāyāṇi ca gandhavanti pittajvaraṃ yāni śamaṃ nayanti
yathāmaloṣṭaṃ salile niṣiktaṃ samuddhared āśvavilīnam eva
tadvaccikitsettvarayā bhiṣak tam asvedanaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ prayātam
ābhiḥ kriyābhiśca na labdhasaṃjñaḥ sānāhalālāśvasanaśca varjyaḥ
saśarkarair māsam upakrameta viśeṣato jīrṇaghṛtaṃ sa pāyyaḥ
madyamuṣṇaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadam eva ca
rūkṣamāśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca
vidhivat sevyamāne tu madye saṃnihitā guṇāḥ
madena karaṇānāṃ tu bhāvānyatve kṛte sati
tryavasthaśca mado jñeyaḥ pūrvo madhyo 'tha paścimaḥ
nirbhaktamekāntata eva madyaṃ niṣevyamāṇaṃ manujena nityam
uṣṇābhitaptena ca sevyamānaṃ karoti madyaṃ vividhān vikārān
liṅgaṃ parasya tu madasya vadanti tajjñāstṛṣṇāṃ rujāṃ śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedam
jñeyāni tatra bhiṣajā suviniścitāni pittaprakopajanitāni ca kāraṇāni
dveṣaḥ surānnavikṛteṣu ca teṣu teṣu taṃ pānavibhramamuśantyakhilena dhīrāḥ
jihvauṣṭhadantamasitaṃ tvathavāpi nīlaṃ pīte ca yasya nayane rudhiraprabhe ca
hikkājvarau vamathuvepathupārśvaśūlāḥ kāsabhramāvapi ca pānahataṃ bhajante
teṣāṃ nivāraṇamidaṃ hi mayocyamānaṃ vyaktābhidhānamakhilena vidhiṃ nibodha
pṛthvīkadīpyakamahauṣadhahiṅgubhir vā sauvarcalena ca yutaṃ vitaret sukhāya
pittātmake madhuravargakaṣāyamiśraṃ madyaṃ hitaṃ samadhuśarkaram iṣṭagandham
pītvā ca madyam api cekṣurasapragāḍhaṃ niḥśeṣataḥ kṣaṇamavasthitamullikhecca
lāvaiṇatittirirasāṃśca pibedanamlān maudgān sukhāya saghṛtān sasitāṃśca yūṣān
seveta tiktakaṭukāṃśca rasānudārān yūṣāṃśca tiktakaṭukopahitān hitāya
pathyaṃ yavānnavikṛtāni ca jāṅgalāni śleṣmaghnamanyad api yacca niratyayaṃ syāt
kuryācca sarvamatha sarvabhave vidhānaṃ dvandvodbhave dvayamavekṣya yathāpradhānam
sāmānyamanyad api yacca samagramagryaṃ vakṣyāmi yacca manaso madakṛt sukhaṃ ca
piṣṭaiḥ sapadmakayutairapi sārivādyaiḥ sekaṃ jalaiśca vitaredamalaiḥ suśītaiḥ
drākṣāyutaṃ hṛtamalaṃ madirāmayārtaistatpānakaṃ śuci sugandhi narair niṣevyam
piṣṭvā pibecca madhukaṃ kaṭurohiṇīṃ ca drākṣāṃ ca mūlamasakṛt trapuṣībhavaṃ yat
kārpāsinīm atha ca nāgabalāṃ ca tulyāṃ pītvā sukhī bhavati sādhu suvarcalāṃ ca
tadbījapūrakarasāyutamāśu pītaṃ śāntiṃ parāṃ paramade tvacirāt karoti
sauvarcalāyutamudārarasaṃ phalāmlaṃ bhārgīśṛtena ca jalena hito 'vasekaḥ
vipācya tasyāñjalinā vameddhi madyaṃ pibeccāhni gate tvajīrṇe
hṛdyaiḥ khaḍairapi ca bhojanamatra śastaṃ drākṣākapitthaphaladāḍimapānakaṃ yat
kharjūravetrakakarīraparūṣakeṣu drākṣātrivṛtsu ca kṛtaṃ sasitaṃ himaṃ vā
pañcendriyārthaviṣayā mṛdupānayogā hṛdyāḥ sukhāśca manasaḥ satataṃ niṣevyāḥ
drākṣāṃ ca kṛṣṇāmatha keśaraṃ ca kṣīre samāloḍya pibet sukhepsuḥ
bhavecca madyena tu yena pātitaḥ prakāmapītena surāsavādinā
yathā narendropahatasya kasyacidbhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ
dhruvaṃ tathā madyahatasya dehino bhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ
śītaṃ vidhānamata ūrdhvamahaṃ pravakṣye dāhapraśāntikaramṛddhimatāṃ narāṇām
bhinnotpalojjvalahime śayane śayīta patreṣu vā sajalabinduṣu padminīnām
tatrainamamburuhapatrasamaiḥ spṛśantyaḥ śītaiḥ karoruvadanaiḥ kaṭhinaiḥ stanaiśca
tā enamārdravasanāḥ saha saṃviśeyuḥ śliṣṭvābalāḥ śithilamekhalahārayaṣṭyaḥ
sarva eva ca varjyāḥ syuḥ śītagātreṣu dehiṣu
madyāni hṛdyānyatha gandhavanti pītāni sadyaḥ śamayanti tṛṣṇām
pibet surāṃ naiva labheta rogān mano'nuvighnaṃ ca madaṃ na yāti
punaḥ kāṅkṣati toyaṃ ca taṃ tṛṣṇārditamādiśet
dhātukṣayāllaṅghanasūryatāpāt pittaṃ ca vātaśca bhṛśaṃ pravṛddhaḥ
srotāṃsi saṃdūṣayataḥ sametau yānyambuvāhīni śarīriṇāṃ hi
srotaḥsv apāṃvāhiṣu dūṣiteṣu jāyeta tṛṣṇātibalā tatastu
tisraḥ smṛtāstāḥ kṣatajā caturthī kṣayāttathānyāmasamudbhavā ca
syāt saptamī bhaktanimittajā tu nibodha liṅgānyanupūrvaśastu
srotonirodho virasaṃ ca vaktraṃ śītābhir adbhiśca vivṛddhimeti
śītābhikāṅkṣā mukhatiktatā ca pittātmikāyāṃ paridhūpanaṃ ca
nidrā gurutvaṃ madhurāsyatā ca tayārditaḥ śuṣyati cātimātram
kaphātmikāyāṃ gurugātratā ca śākhāsu śophastvavipāka eva
etāni rūpāṇi bhavanti tasyāṃ tayārditaḥ kāṅkṣati nāti cāmbhaḥ
kṣatasya rukśoṇitanirgamābhyāṃ tṛṣṇā caturthī kṣatajā matā tu
tayābhibhūtasya niśādināni gacchanti duḥkhaṃ pibato 'pi toyam
rasakṣayādyā kṣayajā matā sā tayārditaḥ śuṣyati dahyate ca
atyarthamākāṅkṣati cāpi toyaṃ tāṃ sannipātāditi kecidāhuḥ
snigdhaṃ tathāmlaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca bhuktaṃ gurvannam evātitṛṣāṃ karoti
gaṇḍūṣamamlair virase ca vaktre kuryācchubhairāmalakasya cūrṇaiḥ
suvarṇarūpyādibhiragnitaptair loṣṭaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā sikatādibhir vā
jalaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ śamayettu tṛṣṇāṃ saśarkaraṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ himaṃ vā
pañcāṅgikāḥ pañcagaṇā ya uktāsteṣvambu siddhaṃ prathame gaṇe vā
pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ manujo 'cireṇa tṛṣo vimucyeta hi vātajāyāḥ
pittaghnavargaistu kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ saśarkaraḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ suśītaḥ
pītastṛṣāṃ pittakṛtāṃ nihanti kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ vāpyatha jīvanīyaiḥ
hitaṃ bhavecchardanam eva cātra taptena nimbaprasavodakena
sarvāsu tṛṣṇāsvathavāpi paittaṃ kuryādvidhiṃ tena hi tā na santi
vargasya siddhasya ca sārivādeḥ pātavyamambhaḥ śiśiraṃ tṛṣārtaiḥ
sasārivādau tṛṇapañcamūle tathotpalādau prathame gaṇe ca
kuryāt kaṣāyaṃ ca yatheritena madhūkapuṣpādiṣu cāpareṣu
rājādanakṣīrikapītaneṣu ṣaṭ pānakānyatra hitāni ca syuḥ
kṣayotthitāṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ nihanyānmāṃsodakaṃ vā madhukodakaṃ vā
gurvannajātāṃ vamanair jayecca kṣayādṛte sarvakṛtāṃ ca tṛṣṇām
śramodbhavāṃ māṃsaraso nihanti guḍodakaṃ vāpyathavāpi manthaḥ
yā snehapītasya bhavecca tṛṣṇā tatroṣṇamambhaḥ prapibenmanuṣyaḥ
madyodbhavāmardhajalaṃ nihanti madyaṃ tṛṣāṃ yāpi ca madyapasya
tṛṣṇodbhavāṃ hanti jalaṃ suśītaṃ saśarkaraṃ sekṣurasaṃ tathāmbhaḥ
svaiḥ svaiḥ kaṣāyair vamanāni tāsāṃ tathā jvaroktāni ca pācanāni
saṃśodhanaṃ kṣīrarasau ghṛtāni sarvāsu lehānmadhurān himāṃśca
pūrvarūpaṃ mataṃ chardyā yathāsvaṃ ca vibhāvayet
śrāntaḥ saghoṣaṃ bahuśaḥ kaṣāyaṃ jīrṇe 'dhikaṃ sānilajā vamistu
yo 'mlaṃ bhṛśaṃ vā kaṭutiktavaktraḥ pītaṃ saraktaṃ haritaṃ vamedvā
yo hṛṣṭaromā madhuraṃ prabhūtaṃ śuklaṃ himaṃ sāndrakaphānuviddham
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti yasyāṃ sā sarvadoṣaprabhavā matā tu
bībhatsajā dauhṛdajāmajā ca sātmyaprakopāt kṛmijā ca yā hi
sā pañcamī tāṃ ca vibhāvayettu doṣocchrayeṇaiva yathoktamādau
āmāśayotkleśabhavā hi sarvāstasmāddhitaṃ laṅghanam eva tāsu
tarpaṇaṃ vā madhuyutaṃ tisṛṇām api bheṣajam
jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni śubhāni pānakāni ca
sa ghoṣavānāśu hinastyasūn yatastatastu hikketi bhiṣagbhirucyate
annajāṃ yamalāṃ kṣudrāṃ gambhīrāṃ mahatīṃ tathā
vāyuḥ kaphenānugataḥ pañca hikkāḥ karoti hi
cireṇa yamalair vegair yā hikkā sampravartate
kṣudrikā nāma sā hikkā jatrumūlāt pradhāvitā
āyamyate hikkato 'ṅgāni yasya dṛṣṭiścordhvaṃ tāmyate yasya gāḍham
kṣīṇo 'nnadviṭ kāsate yaśca hikkī tau dvāvantyau varjayeddhikkamānau
yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vā mākṣikeṇāvapīḍe pippalyo vā śarkarācūrṇayuktāḥ
sarpiḥ koṣṇaṃ kṣīramikṣo raso vā nātikṣīṇe chardanaṃ śāntihetoḥ
nārīpayaḥpiṣṭamaśuklacandanaṃ ghṛtaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ ca sasaindhavaṃ tathā
cūrṇīkṛtaṃ saindhavamambhasāthavā nihanti hikkāṃ ca hitaṃ ca nasyataḥ
yuñjyāddhūmaṃ śālaniryāsajātaṃ naipālaṃ vā goviṣāṇodbhavaṃ vā
sarpiḥ snigdhaiścarmavālaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā hikkāsthāne svedanaṃ cāpi kāryam
kṣaudropetaṃ gairikaṃ kāñcanāhvaṃ lihyādbhasma grāmyasattvāsthijaṃ vā
svarjikṣāraṃ bījapūrādrasena kṣaudropetaṃ hanti līḍhvāśu hikkām
sarpiḥsnigdhā ghnanti hikkāṃ yavāgvaḥ koṣṇagrāsāḥ pāyaso vā sukhoṣṇaḥ
śuṇṭhītoye sādhitaṃ kṣīramājaṃ tadvat pītaṃ śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ vā
ā tṛpter vā sevyamānaṃ nihanyād ghrātaṃ hikkāmāśu mūtraṃ tvajāvyoḥ
pibet palaṃ vā lavaṇottamasya dvābhyāṃ palābhyāṃ haviṣaḥ samagram
kṛṣṇāṃ sitāṃ cāmalakaṃ ca līḍhaṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ madhunāthavāpi
virecanaṃ pathyatamaṃ sasaindhavaṃ ghṛtaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ ca sitopalāyutam
taireva kāraṇaiḥ śvāso ghoro bhavati dehinām
bhidyate sa mahāvyādhiḥ śvāsa eko viśeṣataḥ
ānāhaḥ pārśvayoḥ śūlaṃ vairasyaṃ vadanasya ca
niṣaṇṇasyaiti śāntiṃ ca sa kṣudra iti saṃjñitaḥ
sa śāmyati kaphe hīne svapataśca vivardhate
saṃrabdhanetrastvāyamya yaḥ śvasyāt sa mahān smṛtaḥ
trayaḥ śvāsā na sidhyanti tamako durbalasya ca
śvāse kāse ca hikkāyāṃ hṛdroge cāpi pūjitam
suvahā kālikā bhārgī śukākhyā naiculaṃ phalam
vāsāghṛtaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ cātra hitaṃ bhavet
eṇādīnāṃ śirobhir vā kaulatthā vā susaṃskṛtāḥ
hanyuḥ śvāsaṃ ca kāsaṃ ca saṃskṛtāni payāṃsi ca
timirasya ca bījāni karkaṭākhyā ca cūrṇitā
haridrāṃ maricaṃ drākṣāṃ guḍaṃ rāsnāṃ kaṇāṃ śaṭīm
pippalīṃ maricaṃ caṇḍāṃ gośakṛdrasam eva ca
ete sarve sasarpiṣkā dhūmāḥ kāryā vijānatā
durbale caiva rūkṣe ca tarpaṇaṃ hitam ucyate
lihannaraḥ śvāsanipīḍito hi śvāsaṃ jayatyeva balāttryaheṇa
yathāgniriddhaḥ pavanānuviddho vajraṃ yathā vā surarājamuktam
rogāstathaite khalu durnivārāḥ śvāsaśca kāsaśca vilambikā ca
uktā ye hetavo nṝṇāṃ rogayoḥ śvāsahikkayoḥ
nireti vaktrāt sahasā sadoṣaḥ kāsaḥ sa vidvadbhirudāhṛtastu
pañcaprakāraḥ kathito bhiṣagbhir vivardhito yakṣmavikārakṛt syāt
prasaktam antaḥkapham īraṇena kāsettu śuṣkaṃ svarabhedayuktaḥ
pittena pītāni vamet kaṭūni kāset sa pāṇḍuḥ paridahyamānaḥ
viśliṣṭavakṣāḥ sa naraḥ saraktaṃ ṣṭhīvatyabhīkṣṇaṃ kṣatajaṃ tamāhuḥ
śuṣyan viniṣṭhīvati durbalastu prakṣīṇamāṃso rudhiraṃ sapūyam
vṛddhatvamāsādya bhavettu yo vai yāpyaṃ tamāhurbhiṣajastu kāsam
uṣṇāmbunā hiṅguyutaṃ tu pītvā baddhāsyamapyāśu jahāti kāsam
pathyāṃ sitāmāmalakāni lājāṃ samāgadhīṃ cāpi vicūrṇya śuṇṭhīm
sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vilihīta kāsī sasaindhavāṃ voṣṇajalena kṛṣṇām
drākṣāṃ sitāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ madhukaṃ tugāṃ ca
hareṇukāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāṃ dadhnā pibet kāsagadābhibhūtaḥ
ubhe haridre suradāruśuṇṭhīṃ gāyatrisāraṃ ca pibet samāṃśam
bastasya mūtreṇa sukhāmbunā vā dantīṃ dravantīṃ ca satilvakākhyām
bhṛṣṭāni sarpīṃṣyatha bādarāṇi khādet palāśāni sasaindhavāni
kṣaudreṇa lihyānmaricāni vāpi bhārgīvacāhiṅgukṛtā ca vartiḥ
dhūme praśastā ghṛtasamprayuktā veṇutvagelālavaṇaiḥ kṛtā vā
pibecca sīdhuṃ maricānvitaṃ vā tenāśu kāsaṃ jayati prasahya
ebhir niṣeveta kṛtāṃ ca peyāṃ tanvīṃ suśītāṃ madhunā vimiśrām
yat plīhni sarpirvihitaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tadvātakāsaṃ jayati prasahya
vidārigandhādikṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā rasena vā vāsakajena pakvam
dhūmaṃ pibet snaihikamapramattaḥ pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ ghṛtam eva cātra
hitā yavāgvaśca raseṣu siddhāḥ payāṃsi lehāḥ saghṛtāstathaiva
uṣṇāśca lehāḥ kaṭukā nihanyuḥ kaphaṃ viśeṣeṇa viśoṣaṇaṃ ca
kaṭutrikaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṛmighnasvarase vipakvam
nirguṇḍipatrasvarase ca pakvaṃ sarpiḥ kaphotthaṃ vinihanti kāsam
vidārigandhotpalasārivādīn niṣkvāthya vargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam
ghṛtaṃ pacedikṣurasāmbudugdhaiḥ kākolivarge ca saśarkaraṃ tat
prātaḥ pibet pittakṛte ca kāse ratiprasūte kṣataje ca kāse
kṣaudreṇa kāse kṣataje kṣayotthe pibedghṛtaṃ cekṣurase vipakvam
cūrṇaṃ pibedāmalakasya vāpi kṣīreṇa pakvaṃ saghṛtaṃ hitāśī
kāseṣu peyastriṣu kāsavadbhiḥ kṣīreṇa sakṣaudraghṛtena vāpi
guḍodakaṃ vā kvathitaṃ pibeddhi kṣaudreṇa śītaṃ maricopadaṃśam
dattvā trivṛccūrṇapalāni cāṣṭāvaṣṭau ca tailasya pacedyathāvat
śāmyanti cāyaṃ ciramantaragnerhatasya puṃstvasya ca vṛddhihetuḥ
strīṇāṃ ca vandhyāmayanāśanaḥ syāt kalyāṇako nāma guḍaḥ pratītaḥ
dvipālikān nyasya yavāḍhakaṃ ca harītakīnāṃ ca śataṃ gurūṇām
droṇe jalasyāḍhakasaṃyute ca kvāthe kṛte pūtacaturthabhāge
pacettulāṃ śuddhaguḍasya dattvā pṛthak ca tailāt kuḍavaṃ ghṛtācca
cūrṇaṃ ca tāvanmagadhodbhavāyā deyaṃ ca tasminmadhu siddhaśīte
rasāyanāt karṣamato vilihyāddve cābhaye nityamathāśu hanyāt
pacedghṛtaṃ tattu niṣevyamāṇaṃ hanyāt kṣatotthaṃ kṣayajaṃ ca kāsam
śatāvarīnāgabalāvipakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidheyaṃ ca hitāya kāsinām
srotaḥsu te svaravaheṣu gatāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ hanyuḥ svaraṃ bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ saḥ
vātena kṛṣṇanayanānanamūtravarcā bhinnaṃ śanair vadati gadgadavat svaraṃ ca
kṛcchrāt kaphena satataṃ kapharuddhakaṇṭho mandaṃ śanair vadati cāpi divā viśeṣaḥ
dhūpyeta vāk kṣayakṛte kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgeṣa cāpi hatavāk parivarjanīyaḥ
kṣīṇasya vṛddhasya kṛśasya cāpi cirotthito yaśca sahopajātaḥ
medasvinaḥ sarvasamudbhavaśca svarāmayo yo na sa siddhimeti
yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhirādita eva coktastaṃ cāpyaśeṣamavatārayituṃ yateta
vaiśeṣikaṃ ca vidhimūrdhvamato vadāmi taṃ vai svarāturahitaṃ nikhilaṃ nibodha
kṣīrānupānaṃ pitte tu pibet sarpir atandritaḥ
lihyādvā madhutailābhyāṃ bhuktvā khādet kaṭūni vā
dhamanyāṃ raktajānāṃ ca prasavaḥ prāyaśaḥ smṛtaḥ
jvaro vivarṇatā śūlaṃ hṛdrogaḥ sadanaṃ bhramaḥ
keśādādyās tv adṛśyās te dvāvādyau parivarjayet
pratyāgate nirūhe tu naraṃ snātaṃ sukhāmbunā
khādet pūpalikāḥ pakvā dhānyāmlaṃ ca pibedanu
niṣkvāthena viḍaṅgānāṃ cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ tu tat
kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtāni caiva dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti
na vegān dhārayet prājño vātādīnāṃ jijīviṣuḥ
āṭopaśūlau parikartanaṃ ca saṅgaḥ purīṣasya tathordhvavātaḥ
purīṣamāsyād api vā nireti purīṣavege 'bhihate narasya
mūtrasya vege 'bhihate narastu kṛcchreṇa mūtraṃ kurute 'lpamalpam
ānaddhabastiśca bhavanti tīvrāḥ śūlāśca śūlairiva bhinnamūrteḥ
ānandajaṃ śokasamudbhavaṃ vā netrodakaṃ prāptam amuñcato hi
śirogurutvaṃ nayanāmayāśca bhavanti tīvrāḥ saha pīnasena
chardervighātena bhavecca kuṣṭhaṃ yenaiva doṣeṇa vidagdham annam
mūtrāśaye pāyuni muṣkayośca śopho rujo mūtravinigrahaśca
śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhavedvā te te vikārā vihate tu śukre
tandrāṅgamardārucivibhramāḥ syuḥ kṣudho 'bhighātāt kṛśatā ca dṛṣṭeḥ
sāmānyataḥ pṛthaktvena kriyāṃ bhūyo nibodha me
elāṃ vāpyatha madyena kṣīraṃ vāpi pibennaraḥ
māṃsopadaṃśaṃ madhu vā pibedvā sīdhu gauḍikam
bhadradāru ghanaṃ mūrvā haridrā madhukaṃ tathā
yacca yatra bhavetprāptaṃ tacca tasmin prayojayet
bhojanaiḥ kupitaḥ sadya udāvartaṃ karoti hi
ārevataphalaṃ cāpsu paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet
gavāṃ mūtreṇa tā vartīḥ kārayettu gudānugāḥ
vaivarṇyakampau hṛdaye rujaśca bhavanti tasyāṃ śirasaśca bhedaḥ
duṣṭaṃ tu bhuktaṃ kaphamārutābhyāṃ pravartate nordhvamadhaśca yasya
yatrasthamāmaṃ virujet tam eva deśaṃ viśeṣeṇa vikārajātaiḥ
sādhyāsu pārṣṇyor dahanaṃ praśastam agnipratāpo vamanaṃ ca tīkṣṇam
pakve tato 'nne tu vilaṅghanaṃ syāt saṃpācanaṃ cāpi virecanaṃ ca
viśuddhadehasya hi sadya eva mūrcchātisārādirupaiti śāntim
āsthāpanaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ sarvāsu yogānaparānnibodha
sukhāmbupītaṃ vinihantyajīrṇaṃ śūlaṃ visūcīmaruciṃ ca sadyaḥ
kṣārāgadaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ viṣaṃ vā guḍapragāḍhānatha sarṣapān vā
amlena vā saindhavahiṅguyuktau sabījapūrṇau saghṛtau trivargau
kaṭutrikaṃ vā lavaṇairupetaṃ pibet snuhīkṣīravimiśritaṃ tu
kalyāṇakaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ pibettu yaduktam ādāvanilāmayeṣu
dantīyutaṃ vā magadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibet koṣavatīrasena
vyoṣaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ haridre mūlaṃ samaṃ cāpyatha mātuluṅgyāḥ
suvāmitaṃ sādhuvirecitaṃ vā sulaṅghitaṃ vā manujaṃ viditvā
āmaṃ śakṛdvā nicitaṃ krameṇa bhūyo vibaddhaṃ viguṇānilena
āmāśaye śūlamatho gurutvaṃ hṛllāsa udgāravighātanaṃ ca
stambhaḥ kaṭīpṛṣṭhapurīṣamūtre śūlo 'tha mūrcchā sa śakṛdvamecca
athetaraṃ yo na śakṛdvamettamāmaṃ jayet svedanapācanaiśca
tānyeva vartīr viraced vicūrṇya mahiṣyajāvībhagavāṃ tu mūtraiḥ
svinnasya pāyau viniveśya tāśca cūrṇāni caiṣāṃ pradhamettu nāḍyā
mūtreṣu saṃsādhya yathāvidhānaṃ dravyāṇi yānyūrdhvamadhaśca yānti
eṣveva tailena ca sādhitena prāptaṃ yadi syādanuvāsayecca
doṣaiḥ pṛthak saha ca cittaviparyayācca bhaktāyaneṣu hṛdi cāvatate pragāḍham
nānne rucirbhavati taṃ bhiṣajo vikāraṃ bhaktopaghātamiha pañcavidhaṃ vadanti
hṛcchūlapīḍanayutaṃ virasānanatvaṃ vātātmake bhavati liṅgamarocake tu
hṛddāhacoṣabahutā mukhatiktatā ca mūrcchā satṛḍ bhavati pittakṛte tathaiva
sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā bahūni rūpāṇyathāsya hṛdaye samudīrayanti
vāte vacāmbuvamanaṃ kṛtavān pibecca snehaiḥ surābhirathavoṣṇajalena cūrṇam
pitte guḍāmbumadhurair vamanaṃ praśastaṃ snehaḥ sasaindhavasitāmadhusarpiriṣṭaḥ
nimbāmbuvāmitavataḥ kaphaje 'nupānaṃ rājadrumāmbu madhunā tu sadīpyakaṃ syāt
cūrṇaṃ yaduktamathavānilaje tadeva sarvaiśca sarvakṛtamevam upakrameta
bījaiḥ karañjanṛpavṛkṣabhavaiśca piṣṭair lehaṃ pacet surabhimūtrayutaṃ yathāvat
mustāṃ vacāṃ trikaṭukaṃ rajanīdvayaṃ ca bhārgīṃ ca kuṣṭhamatha nirdahanīṃ ca piṣṭvā
mūtre 'vije dviradamūtrayute pacedvā pāṭhāṃ tugāmativiṣāṃ rajanīṃ ca mukhyām
maṇḍūkimarkamamṛtāṃ ca salāṅgalākhyāṃ mūtre pacettu mahiṣasya vidhānavidvā
etānna santi caturo lihatastu lehān gulmāruciśvasanakaṇṭhahṛdāmayāśca
sātmyān svadeśaracitān vividhāṃśca bhakṣyān pānāni mūlaphalaṣāḍavarāgayogān
adyādrasāṃśca vividhān vividhaiḥ prakārair bhuñjīta cāpi laghurūkṣamanaḥsukhāni
āsthāpanaṃ vidhivadatra virecanaṃ ca kuryānmṛdūni śirasaśca virecanāni
mūtrāsavair guḍakṛtaiśca tathā tvariṣṭaiḥ kṣārāsavaiśca madhumādhavatulyagandhaiḥ
syādeṣa eva kaphavātahate vidhiśca śāntiṃ gate hutabhuji praśamāya tasya
icchābhighātabhayaśokahate 'ntaragnau bhāvān bhavāya vitaret khalu śakyarūpān
dainyaṃ gate manasi bodhanamatra śastaṃ yadyat priyaṃ tadupasevyamarocake tu
mūtraukasādau dvau cāpi rogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ
vātakuṇḍalikāṃ taṃ tu vyādhiṃ vidyāt sudāruṇam
vedanā ca parā bastau vātāṣṭhīleti tāṃ viduḥ
vegaṃ saṃdhārya mūtrasya yo bhūyaḥ sraṣṭumicchati
tasya nābhyeti yadi vā kathaṃcit sampravartate
bastau vāpyathavā nāle maṇau vā yasya dehinaḥ
mūtraṃ pravṛttaṃ sajjeta saraktaṃ vā pravāhataḥ
abhyantare bastimukhe vṛtto 'lpaḥ sthira eva ca
bastiṃ meḍhraṃ gudaṃ caiva pradahan srāvayedadhaḥ
mūtraṃ hāridramathavā saraktaṃ raktam eva vā
viśadaṃ pītakaṃ mūtraṃ sadāhaṃ bahalaṃ tathā
tālasya taruṇaṃ mūlaṃ trapusasya rasaṃ tathā
śvetaṃ karkaṭakaṃ caiva prātastu payasā pibet
śṛtaṃ vā madhuraiḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirmiśraṃ pibennaraḥ
pibedguḍena miśraṃ vā lihyāllehān pṛthak pṛthak
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūtradoṣe kramaṃ hitam
vidhānaṃ tasya pūrvaṃ hi vyāsataḥ parikīrtitam
kṣaudrārdhapātraṃ dattvā ca pātraṃ tu kṣīrasarpiṣaḥ
śarkarāyāśca cūrṇaṃ ca drākṣācūrṇaṃ ca tatsamam
tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ cūrṇaṃ līḍhvā kṣīraṃ tataḥ pibet
etat sarpiḥ prayuñjānaḥ śuddhadeho naraḥ sadā
tat siddhaṃ kalaśe sthāpyaṃ kṣaudraprasthena saṃyutam
tasya khādedyathāśakti mātrāṃ kṣīraṃ tataḥ pibet
prajñāhitaṃ ca dhanyaṃ ca sarvarogāpahaṃ śivam
ādhmānaṃ ca saśūlaṃ ca mūtrasaṅgaṃ karoti hi
śarkarāyā viśeṣaṃ tu śṛṇu kīrtayato mama
hṛtpīḍā vepathuḥ śūlaṃ kukṣau vahniḥ sudurbalaḥ
tābhir bhavati mūrcchā ca mūtrāghātaśca dāruṇaḥ
aśmarīṃ ca samāśritya yaduktaṃ prasamīkṣya tat
yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjīta snehādim api ca kramam
tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā tat peyaṃ tena vāpyanuvāsanam
pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ pittakṛcchraṃ nāśayet kṣīram eva vā
ye tvanye tu tathā kṛcchre tayoḥ proktaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ
aśuciṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ kṣataṃ vā yadi vākṣatam
devāstathā śatrugaṇāśca teṣāṃ gandharvayakṣāḥ pitaro bhujaṅgāḥ
rakṣāṃsi yā cāpi piśācajātireṣo 'ṣṭako devagaṇo grahākhyaḥ
saṃtuṣṭaḥ śucirapi ceṣṭagandhamālyo nistandrī hy avitathasaṃskṛtaprabhāṣī
tejasvī sthiranayano varapradātā brahmaṇyo bhavati naraḥ sa devajuṣṭaḥ
saṃtuṣṭo bhavati na cānnapānajātair duṣṭātmā bhavati ca devaśatrujuṣṭaḥ
nṛtyan vai prahasati cāru cālpaśabdaṃ gandharvagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ
tejasvī vadati ca kiṃ dadāmi kasmai yo yakṣagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ
pretebhyo visṛjati saṃstareṣu piṇḍān śāntātmā jalam api cāpasavyavastraḥ
bhūmau yaḥ prasarati sarpavat kadācit sṛkkiṇyau vilikhati jihvayā tathaiva
krodhālurvipulabalo niśāvihārī śaucadviḍ bhavati ca rakṣasā gṛhītaḥ
bahvāśī vijanahimāmburātrisevī vyāvigno bhramati rudan piśācajuṣṭaḥ
sthūlākṣastvaritagatiḥ svaphenalehī nidrāluḥ patati ca kampate ca yo 'ti
yaścādridviradanagādivicyutaḥ san saṃsṛṣṭo na bhavati vārddhakena juṣṭaḥ
kṛṣṇakṣaye ca pitaraḥ pañcamyām api coragāḥ
darpaṇādīn yathā chāyā śītoṣṇaṃ prāṇino yathā
svamaṇiṃ bhāskarasyosrā yathā dehaṃ ca dehadhṛk
tapāṃsi tīvrāṇi tathaiva dānaṃ vratāni dharmo niyamāśca satyam
guṇāstathāṣṭāvapi teṣu nityā vyastāḥ samastāśca yathāprabhāvam
na te manuṣyaiḥ saha saṃviśanti na vā manuṣyān kvacidāviśanti
yāni yeṣāṃ yatheṣṭāni tāni tebhyaḥ pradāpayet
hiṃsanti manujān yeṣu prāyaśo divaseṣu tu
na śakyā balibhir jetuṃ yogaistān samupācaret
hiṅguṃ mūtraṃ ca bastasya dhūmamasya prayojayet
etena śāmyati kṣipraṃ balavān api yo grahaḥ
saindhavaṃ kaṭukāṃ hiṅguṃ vayaḥsthāṃ ca vacām api
ye ye grahā na sidhyanti sarveṣāṃ nayanāñjanam
golomī cājalomī ca bhūtakeśī jaṭā tathā
naipālī haritālaṃ ca rakṣoghnā ye ca kīrtitāḥ
asmin varge bhiṣak kuryāttailāni ca ghṛtāni ca
tataḥ prāpsyati siddhiṃ ca yaśaśca vipulaṃ bhiṣak
hṛtkampaḥ śūnyatā svedo dhyānaṃ mūrcchā pramūḍhatā
dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ vivṛtākṣaḥ patet kṣitau
alpakālāntaraṃ cāpi punaḥ saṃjñāṃ labheta saḥ
so 'pasmāra iti proktaḥ sa ca dṛṣṭaścaturvidhaḥ
vepamāno daśan dantān śvasan phenaṃ vamann api
tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt sa pittabhava ucyate
tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt so 'pasmāraḥ kaphātmakaḥ
pralāpaḥ kūjanaṃ kleśaḥ pratyekaṃ tu bhavediha
deve varṣatyapi yathā bhūmau bījāni kānicit
tasya kāryo vidhiḥ sarvo ya unmādeṣu vakṣyate
tataḥ sidhyanti te sarve yogairanyaiśca sādhayet
pitteṣu siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pānābhyaṅgeṣu pūjitam
pūjāṃ rudrasya kurvīta tadgaṇānāṃ ca nityaśaḥ
jaṭilāṃ pañcamūlyau dve pathyāṃ cotkvāthya yatnataḥ
śuddhe kumbhe nidadhyācca saṃbhāraṃ taṃ surāṃ tataḥ
sirāṃ vidhyedatha prāptāṃ maṅgalyāni ca dhārayet
mānasena ca duḥkhena sa pañcavidha ucyate
rūkṣacchaviḥ paruṣavāgdhamanītato vā śītāturaḥ kṛśatanuḥ sphuritāṅgasandhiḥ
āsphoṭayatyaṭati gāyati nṛtyaśīlo vikrośati bhramati cāpyanilaprakopāt
tīkṣṇo himāmbuni caye 'pi sa vahniśaṅkī pittāddivā nabhasi paśyati tārakāśca
nidrāparo 'lpakathano 'lpabhuguṣṇasevī rātrau bhṛśaṃ bhavati cāpi kaphaprakopāt
sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā yathāsvaṃ saṃharṣitā iva ca liṅgamudīrayanti
gāḍhaṃ kṣate manasi ca priyayā riraṃsor jāyeta cotkaṭataro manaso vikāraḥ
citraṃ sa jalpati mano'nugataṃ visaṃjño gāyatyatho hasati roditi mūḍhasaṃjñaḥ
raktekṣaṇo hatabalendriyabhāḥ sudīnaḥ śyāvānano viṣakṛto 'tha bhavet parāsuḥ
yojayitvā tu taccūrṇaṃ ghrāṇe tasya prayojayet
sarṣapānāṃ ca tailena nasyābhyaṅgau hitau sadā
bhīmākārair narair nāgair dāntair vyālaiśca nirviṣaiḥ
bhīṣayet saṃyataṃ pāśaiḥ kaśābhir vātha tāḍayet
tryahāt tryahād yavāgūśca tarpaṇān vā pradāpayet
hṛdyaṃ yaddīpanīyaṃ ca tatpathyaṃ tasya bhojayet
khyātaṃ phalaghṛtaṃ strīṇāṃ vandhyānāṃ cāśu garbhadam
brahmīmaindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu surāṃ jaṭām
viṣaghnīṃ laśunaṃ rāsnāṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām
viṣaje mṛdupūrvāṃ ca viṣaghnīṃ kārayet kriyām
doṣāṇāṃ tatra matimān triṣaṣṭiṃ tu prayojayet

śīghraṃ vipākam upayāti balaṃ na hiṃsyādannāvṛtaṃ na ca muhur vadanānnireti
pītaṃ yadannam upayujya tadūrdhvakāye hanyādgadān bahuvidhāṃśca balaṃ dadāti
madhye tu pītam apahantyavisāribhāvād ye madhyadehamabhibhūya bhavanti rogāḥ
antarābhaktaṃ nāma yadantarā pīyate pūrvāparayor bhaktayoḥ
pathyaṃ sabhaktam abalābalayor hi nityaṃ taddveṣiṇām api tathā śiśuvṛddhayośca
hṛdyaṃ manobalakaraṃ tvatha dīpanaṃ ca pathyaṃ sadā bhavati cāntarabhaktakaṃ yat
doṣe dvidhā pravisṛte tu samudgasaṃjñamādyantayor yadaśanasya niṣevyate tu
śvāse muhurmuhuratiprasṛte ca kāse hikkāvamīṣu sa vadantyupayojyametat
grāseṣu cūrṇamabalāgniṣu dīpanīyaṃ vājīkarāṇyapi tu yojayituṃ yateta
visṛṣṭe viṇmūtre viśadakaraṇe dehe ca sulaghau
viśuddhe codgāre hṛdi suvimale vāte ca sarati
pradeyastvāhāro bhavati bhiṣajāṃ kālaḥ sa tu mataḥ

tadyathā adhikaraṇaṃ yogaḥ padārthaḥ hetvarthaḥ uddeśaḥ nirdeśaḥ upadeśaḥ apadeśaḥ pradeśaḥ atideśaḥ apavarjaḥ vākyaśeṣaḥ arthāpattiḥ viparyayaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ekāntaḥ anekāntaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ nirṇayaḥ anumataṃ vidhānam anāgatāvekṣaṇam atikrāntāvekṣaṇaṃ saṃśayaḥ vyākhyānaṃ svasaṃjñā nirvacanaṃ nidarśanaṃ niyogaḥ vikalpaḥ samuccayaḥ ūhyam iti
atrāsāṃ tantrayuktīnāṃ kiṃ prayojanam ucyate vākyayojanamarthayojanaṃ ca
vyaktā noktāstu ye hyarthā līnā ye cāpyanirmalāḥ
leśoktā ye ca kecitsyusteṣāṃ cāpi prasādhanam
tatra yamarthamadhikṛtyocyate tadadhikaraṇaṃ yathā rasaṃ doṣaṃ vā
siddhaṃ balābhyāṃ ca sadevadāru hitāya nityaṃ galagaṇḍaroge
ityatra tailaṃ siddhaṃ pibediti prathamaṃ vaktavye tṛtīyapāde siddhamiti prayuktam evaṃ dūrasthānām api padānāmekīkaraṇaṃ yogaḥ
yo 'rtho 'bhihitaḥ sūtre pade vā sa padārthaḥ padasya padayoḥ padānāṃ vārthaḥ padārtho 'parimitāśca padārthāḥ

yathā snehasvedāñjaneṣu nirdiṣṭeṣu dvayostrayāṇāṃ vārthānām upapattirdṛśyate tatra yo 'rthaḥ pūrvāparayogasiddho bhavati sa grahītavyo yathā devotpattimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma ityukte saṃdihyate buddhiḥ katamasya vedasyotpattiṃ vakṣyatīti yataḥ ṛgvedādayastu vedāḥ vida vicāraṇe vidﾱ lābhe ityetayośca dhātvoranekārthayoḥ prayogāttatra pūrvāparayogam upalabhya pratipattirbhavati āyurvedotpattimayaṃ vivakṣuriti eṣa padārthaḥ
yathā mṛtpiṇḍo 'dbhiḥ praklidyate tathā māṣadugdhaprabhṛtibhir vraṇaḥ praklidyata iti
yathā tathā na jāgṛyādrātrau divāsvapnaṃ ca varjayet iti
yena padenānuktena vākyaṃ samāpyeta sa vākyaśeṣaḥ
yathā śiraḥpāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarorasām ityukte puruṣagrahaṇaṃ vināpi gamyate puruṣasyeti
yathā odanaṃ bhokṣye ityukte 'rthādāpannaṃ bhavati nāyaṃ pipāsuryavāgūm iti
yathā kṛśālpaprāṇabhīravo duścikitsyā ityukte viparītaṃ gṛhyate dṛḍhādayaḥ sucikitsyā iti
prakaraṇāntareṇa samāpanaṃ prasaṅgo yadvā prakaraṇāntarito yo 'rtho 'sakṛduktaḥ samāpyate sa prasaṅgaḥ

yathā pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣastasmin kriyā so 'dhiṣṭhānamiti vedotpattāvabhidhāya bhūtacintāyāṃ punaruktaṃ yato 'bhihitaṃ pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣa iti sa khalveṣa karmapuruṣaścikitsādhikṛta iti
yathā kecidācāryā bruvate dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ kecidrasaṃ kecidvīryaṃ kecidvipākam iti
yathā kathaṃ vātanimittāścatvāraḥ pramehā asādhyā bhavantīti
yathā śarīraṃ prapīḍya paścādadho gatvā vasāmedomajjānuviddhaṃ mūtraṃ visṛjati vāta evamasādhyā vātajā iti
yathā anyo brūyāt sapta rasā iti tac cāpratiṣedhād anumanyate kathaṃcid iti
yathā cikitsiteṣu brūyāt ślokasthāne yadīritam iti
yathā talahṛdayābhighātaḥ prāṇaharaḥ pāṇipādacchedanam aprāṇaharam iti
yathā iha pañcaviṃśatikaḥ puruṣo vyākhyāyate anyeṣvāyurvedatantreṣu bhūtādiprabhṛtyārabhya cintā
yathā mithunamiti madhusarpiṣor grahaṇaṃ lokaprasiddham udāharaṇaṃ vā
yathā agnirvāyunā sahitaḥ kakṣe vṛddhiṃ gacchati tathā vātapittakaphaduṣṭo vraṇa iti

yathā abhihitam annapānavidhau caturvidhaṃ cānnam upadiśyate bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyaṃ peyam iti evaṃ caturvidhe vaktavye dvividham abhihitam idam atrohyam annapāne viśiṣṭayor dvayor grahaṇe kṛte caturṇām api grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti caturvidhaścāhāraḥ praviralaḥ prāyeṇa dvividha eva ato dvitvaṃ prasiddham iti
kiṃcānyat annena bhakṣyam avaruddhaṃ ghanasādharmyāt peyena lehyaṃ dravasādharmyāt
sa pūjārho bhiṣakśreṣṭha iti dhanvantarer matam
kati tatraikaśo jñeyā dviśo vāpyathavā triśaḥ
trayo doṣā dhātavaśca purīṣaṃ mūtram eva ca
dehaṃ saṃdhārayantyete hy avyāpannā rasair hitaiḥ
rogāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ yacchataṃ viṃśatireva ca
vyāsataḥ kīrtitaṃ taddhi bhinnā doṣāstrayo guṇāḥ
traya eva pṛthak doṣā dviśo nava samādhikaiḥ
pañcāśad evaṃ tu saha bhavanti kṣayam āgataiḥ
bhiṣak kartātha karaṇaṃ rasā doṣāstu kāraṇam
evam etad aśeṣeṇa tantram uttaram ṛddhimat
sahottaraṃ tvetad adhītya sarvaṃ brāhmaṃ vidhānena yathoditena
na hīyate 'rthān manaso 'bhyupetād etadvaco brāhmam atīva satyam
